Operator release: {{ .Release.Name }} in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

  kubectl get deployment -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  kubectl get bitrixclusters -A

CRDs are cluster-scoped. Helm uninstall preserves CRDs, BitrixCluster objects and uploads PVCs.
Helm upgrade/rollback does not migrate CRDs or application databases.
Before an operator upgrade, review compatibility and apply the matching CRD explicitly.

Create application Secrets and configure external DB/Redis, StorageClass and release image
before creating a BitrixCluster. This chart does not install those dependencies.
